bio.text: Mike Beltran is the Republican candidate for Florida's 14th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2018 to 2024.

He was born in New York City and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Pennsylvania in 2005 and a law degree from Harvard in 2008. He worked as a litigator and as a law clerk to U.S. District Judge Steven D. Merryday.
